description:
Spend exactly one use of a lease, atomically. Blocks replay, expiry, revocation and overuse.
    Returns decision allow/block with a named reason plus an Ed25519 decision receipt.
    If a previous attempt timed out, call this again with the SAME use_nonce: a replay returns
    reason=replay — do not retry the write, reconcile it. ~$0.02/call.

action.description: What you are about to do, for the ledger trail.
action.title: Action

agent_id.description: Caller identity; must match the lease holder unless it was issued to '*'.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

lease_token.description: Signed lease token from vc_lease_issue (alternative to lease_id).
lease_token.title: Lease Token

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE if not using X-Vibes-Key.
payment_signature.title: Payment Signature

use_nonce.description: Stable id for this attempt (the replay key). Reuse the SAME nonce on retry.
use_nonce.title: Use Nonce

name: vc_lease_consume
